item.description: The Taiwan Technical Mission in Papua New Guinea has reached an understanding with the Bumayong Lutheran Secondary School in Morobe for smallholder agriculture mechanization empowerment project. TTM PNG leader Chinyu Lee, BLSS board of governing council chairman Bernard Maladina, and Evangelical Lutheran Church of Papua New Guinea general secretary Bernard Kaisom signed the official document strengthening this partnership at Bumayong Lutheran Secondary on February 25th, 2026. item.title: PNG Chiefs secure “Home Base” with K200 million player’s village at Airways
item.description: The Papua New Guinea Chiefs’ journey toward their 2028 NRL debut reached a major milestone today with the official groundbreaking of the PNG Chiefs Players Village at the Airways Hotel and Residences. The K200 million development, delivered in partnership with the Constantino Group of Companies, will serve as the dedicated residential hub for players, staff, and their families as the club prepares for entry into the Australian National Rugby League (NRL) competition. item.title: HMPNGS Francis Agwi sets sail
item.description: HMPNGS Francis Agwi departed Port Moresby from the Papua New Guinea Defence Force’s (PNGDF) Basilisk Naval Base on Saturday 7 March to travel to Sydney to attend the Royal Australian Navy’s International Fleet Review. HMPNGS Francis Agwi is one of the four Guardian-class Patrol Boats (GCPB) in the PNGDF Maritime element fleet and was gifted by the Australian Government in 2021 through the Pacific Maritime Security Program. item.title: Strengthening community safety through Volunteer Probation Officers
item.description: Communities across Papua New Guinea are set to benefit from safer neighbourhoods and stronger justice services, with the Department of Justice and Attorney General (DJAG) and the Australia–PNG Law and Justice Partnership collaborating to deliver a new training program. The first five-day workshop was held in Daru last month, with 25 Volunteer Probation & Parole Officers (VPOs) building practical skills to support people serving community sentences, make positive changes and avoid reoffending.
